description: NXP FRDM-IMX91S target provisioned from a product-owned UUU script and component artifacts, then verified over the board's USB-C debug UART.

backendNotes.target: The selected UUU command executes the Product-owned .lst script. deploy.image contains exactly one script; its relative pub/ files are supplied as deploy.uuu component artifacts. Set workspace.target.serial to the first CH342/CH343 USB-UART device (usually /dev/ttyACM0 under WSL2) when serialVerify is enabled.
backendNotes.download: Power off first, set SW1[4-1]=0001 (SW1-4..1 = OFF/OFF/OFF/ON), connect USB1 (J5) to the host for UUU, and keep the USB-C debug UART J11 as a separate console connection.
